name: code_reviewer
description: Reviews source code for quality, readability, maintainability, naming conventions, and adherence to language best practices. Use when a developer wants general feedback on code style or structure.

input_schema.query: string — what aspect of code quality the developer is concerned about
input_schema.code: string — the source code to review

output_schema.overall_grade: string — A | B | C | D | F
